_note: Two-plane decomposition for the ui-drawer component build (GH #845 component arm · drawer.intake.md §2/§8 · ADR-0188, build BLOCKED on ratification). OUTSIDE-IN nodes = the intake's S1-S4 slices broken to one-writer-per-file leaves. INSIDE-OUT actions = what the shipped control must DO, sourced from the intake §2's action table (its page-side rows e/i land here as a3's opaque-children obligation — the control carries them WITHOUT owning them; the #845 page lane is a separate manifest later, not this one). Crossed via hosts; every leaf carries the checkable accept predicate per agent-ui-component-testing's bar, incl. the built-output leg (the TKT-0002 class) the intake's motion/geometry claims require. Emitted post-doc-review (the checker's MAJOR: the intake's prose table needed its mechanical coverage evidence).

nodes.label: tag ui-drawer, class UIDrawerElement, folder controls/drawer/, extends UIContainerElement, self-define on import
nodes.accept: `npm test drawer` — jsdom: `customElements.get('ui-drawer')` resolves; instance `instanceof UIContainerElement`; NOT form-associated (no `formAssociated`); naming-gates + family-coherence standing suites stay green

nodes.label: props schema — UIContainerElement.surfaceProps spread + open (boolean, reflected) + persistent (boolean, reflected, ADR-0020 shape) + edge enum ['end','start','bottom'] default 'end' (reflected)
nodes.accept: `npm test drawer` — jsdom: each prop reflect round-trips; an out-of-enum `edge` attribute falls back to `'end'`; `<ui-drawer persistent>` coerces true / absent false (presence-boolean); surface axes present via the spread (the modal precedent)

nodes.label: the dialog part — `<dialog data-part='dialog' data-box>` created ONCE, author children MOVED in at connect (ADR-0017 child-move), render() stays void, scrollFade wired unconditionally over the dialog viewport
nodes.accept: `npm test drawer` — jsdom: after connect every author child lives inside the dialog part; disconnect/reconnect creates NO second dialog and drops no children (idempotence probe); `render()` is the inherited void (no template output); scrollFade attach point asserted

nodes.label: open sync + announce — model→platform effect (open ⇒ showModal()/close(), idempotent guards) + platform→model close listener (this.open as discriminator), close emitted BEFORE toggle, no double-announce on the echo path
nodes.accept: `npm test drawer` — jsdom: setting `open=true/false` drives the dialog; a platform-driven close (dispatching `close` while `open` is still true) syncs `open=false` and emits `close` then `toggle` in that order exactly once; a model-driven close emits exactly once (the ADR-0101 ordering probe, modal's wiring shape)

nodes.label: the persistent gate — `cancel` preventDefault when persistent; rect-wise backdrop-click detection (a click targeting the dialog box OUTSIDE its content rect) ignored when persistent, closes otherwise
nodes.accept: `npm test drawer` — jsdom: with `persistent`, a dispatched `cancel` is defaultPrevented and `open` stays true; without it, the rect-wise branch calls `dialog.close()` on a synthesized outside-rect click (the modal.ts branch shape, unit-probed)

nodes.label: aria forwarding + focus restore — author aria-label/aria-labelledby FORWARDED onto the dialog part (host stays attribute-clean, ADR-0017 cl.5); opener captured before showModal(), restored on every close (cl.4)
nodes.accept: `npm test drawer` — jsdom: an authored `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` ends up on the dialog part and is REMOVED from the host; the host carries no role/aria-* attribute after connect; the opener capture/restore path unit-probed (the real focus proof is n13's browser leg)

actions.label: identify itself under the fleet ui-* tag law as a container-tier, non-form-associated surface
expose open/persistent/edge as reflected typed signals — edge in logical inline names defaulting to 'end'

hold arbitrary author content as OPAQUE children in a scrolling [data-box] body — roster lists, danger rows, reorder/duplicate affordances all page-owned (the intake §6 fence: nothing page-shaped enters the control)
announce every REAL open-state transition (close before toggle, once) so a page or agent two-way bind observes dismissal
dismiss via Escape and scrim click by default, both gated off by persistent
carry the author's accessible name on the dialog part and keep the host aria-clean
dock to the ruled edge with fleet-token surface, slide motion that degrades to instant, and reduced-motion suppression — zero new system roles
mirror its live contract in its descriptor and ship through the public barrel
prove containment, restore-to-opener, dismissal gating, and free typing in an embedded field cross-engine
prove the docked geometry and motion suppression from PRODUCTION CSS, not dev mode
teach the four-cell overlay/docking boundary at the surfaces consumers actually read
demonstrate all three edges, the long-list case, and the embedded-field case live on the site
be agent-emittable as one Drawer catalog row with a two-way open mark
pass the standing gates and independent review before ship

edges.why: the props schema is declared as the class's static props — the class must exist first
the part-once machinery lives in the class's connected() — same file, same writer, class first
the open effect reads the typed open prop; the prop must exist before the effect can watch it
the effect drives showModal()/close() on the dialog part — the part must exist before it can be driven
the gate reads the persistent prop
cancel/click listeners attach to the dialog part
the aria forwarding writes onto the dialog part at its creation site
the CSS scopes to :where(ui-drawer)/@scope (ui-drawer) — the tag must be settled before the sheet can target it
the descriptor's attributes[] fence mirrors the live static props — both must exist for the trip-wire to compare
the browser probes assert the announce/dismissal behavior painted for real — the wiring must exist before the cross-engine proof is worth running
the Escape-vs-persistent and scrim-click probes exercise the gate's real platform paths
the restore-to-opener probe is the real-focus proof of n8's captured-opener mechanism
the built-output probe asserts n9's layout/motion claims survive the production build (the TKT-0002 class)
the doc page derives from the descriptor
the catalog row keys off the descriptor's derived type name entering FLEET_TYPES (ADR-0087)
the demo/gallery specimens instantiate the settled tag
review runs once the gates it grades against are green
